name: Question 7
problem:

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+2y=6{e}^{-5x}.
$$

We wish to solve this equation using the method of variation of parameters (VOP).

Select the correct options below.

$\,$ Solving for $u,$ we have $u(x)=$ {{field-2}}.

$\,$ Therefore, the particular solution is ${y}_{p}(x)=$ {{field-3}}.

Question 7
?
Consider the first-order linear ODE dydx+2y=6e−5x. We wish to solve this equation using the method of variation of parameters (VOP).

Select the correct options below.

According to VOP, we assume a particular solution of the form
 
u(x)e−2x
u(x)e−3x
u(x)e2x
u(x)e5x
u(x)e−5x
.

Solving for u, we have u(x)=
 
−3e−2x
6e−3x
2e−3x
−2e−3x
−2e3x
.

Therefore, the particular solution is yp(x)=
 
−2e−5x
2e−5x
6e−5x
−3e−5x
−2e−2x
.
Submit
